modes.description: The modes of one model. Exactly one mode has the id default and no match: it runs when no other mode matches or a probe gets no reply. Every other mode has a match. Non-default modes are tried in order and the first whose match keys all hold is selected.

modeMatch.description: Keys that must all hold for a mode to be selected. Link, interface signature, strings and bcdDevice are read from the enumerated device; probes read a feature report and are tried last.

modeInterfaceSignature.description: An interface the device must expose, by USB class triple and, optionally, the HID primary usage and the whole endpoint set. Only a raw-USB mode may name endpoints: a HID route reports none.

endpoints.description: The interface's whole endpoint set: each entry pairs with one distinct endpoint and none is left over.

bcdDeviceRange.description: An inclusive range of the device release number, bcdDevice. min must not exceed max.

modeInterface.description: The interfaces this mode drives, an inclusive range of interface numbers; the lowest one the device exposes is bound. first must not exceed last.

modeSession.description: Session steps of this mode. startup overrides the record's output.startup while a HID mode runs; usbStartup overrides the record's raw-USB output.startup writes while a raw-USB mode runs. A session names exactly one.

modeProbe.description: A read of one feature report. A probe never writes. answers: the read succeeds. stalls: the device refuses the read. bytes: the reply holds the given bytes at offset.

gipInitializationAction.$comment: The ids a family offers are in defaults.session.namedPackets of Resources/Protocols/xbox.gip.json; a record naming one the description lacks is rejected by the validators.

hidUsageMap.$comment: Maps HID usages to canonical controls for hid.descriptor. A record's map replaces the family's map whole. Each (page, usage) appears once, an axis range has min below max, and a hat range is 0...7 or 1...8: the Swift decoder and the Python validators enforce the first two. reportID, when present, limits the map to element values of that report.

hidAxisUsage.$comment: A stick axis reads -1...1 and a trigger 0...1 from the element's logical range, or from range when set. deadZone is the fraction of travel around zero (the start of a trigger) that reads as zero; the rest rescales to full travel. inverted flips the sign of a stick or the travel of a trigger.

hidHatUsage.$comment: A hat reads eight positions, north first and clockwise, from the first value of its range; any value outside the range is neutral. Without a range, the element's logical minimum is the first value.

values.$comment: Every key must be a value the mask can hold: 0 up to the mask shifted right by its trailing zero bits. JSON Schema cannot compare a key with the mask, so the Swift decoder checks it.

usbStartupWrite.$comment: A raw-USB startup packet: it has no report, so it never reads as a HID write.

modeEndpoint.description: One endpoint of an endpoint set; every key present must hold.
